hermes_gateway.verification_command: hermes cron list --all && hermes cron runs b11c6b3fe2fe --limit 5

missed_audit_job.name: crypto-paper-forward-missed-audit
missed_audit_job.safety: No market fetch, signal generation, paper run execution, equity snapshot, or backdated trade

monthly_job.name: crypto-paper-forward-monthly
monthly_job.utc_gate: first calendar day at 09:00 UTC only

scheduler_design: Hermes timezone is configured as UTC. Exact cron expressions are read back with +00:00 next-run timestamps. Deterministic UTC wrapper gates, dispatch markers, DuckDB schedule keys, order idempotency keys, and the project process lock provide layered overlap and duplicate protection. A separate 09:36 audit-only job records a missed window without market access or execution.

weekly_job.name: crypto-paper-forward-weekly
weekly_job.utc_gate: launch only from 09:10 through 09:35 UTC; never backdate

windows_task_scheduler_fallback.reason: Not required: Hermes no-agent Windows script launch was actually verified and exact UTC next-run timestamps were read back.
